'''Reya Nell''' was a [[human]] who worked as an [[herbalist]] in [[Point Ueda]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[planet]] [[Ueda]], during the [[High Republic Era]]. She specialized in extracting [[salve]]s from [[Ueda conifer pine]]s and [[sap]] and her secret ingredients helped her to edge out the competition.<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> she stood beside<ref name="LostFound">{{Acolyte|Lost / Found}}</ref> the [[pilot]] [[Trowee Astur]]<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> at a stall just inside the gate to Ueda Point as the [[Sith assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya]] [[Mae's quest|entered]] the city.<ref name="LostFound" />

Nell had dark skin, [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, and black [[hair]] that she wore in a [[braid]] with two decorative coastal [[glitter-shell]]s above the left brow. She wore<ref name="AcolyteVG" /> a brown [[Clothing|duster]]<ref name="LostFound" /> over a [[Ghoat wool|ghoat-wool]] [[Jacket|coat]] that faded from gray down to blue with a brown shirt, brown striated [[boot]]s, gray pants, and a brown belt with a hanging [[holster]] for her black [[blaster pistol]]. Nell also had green coloring on the skin around her eyes.<ref name="AcolyteVG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reya Nell first appeared in "[[Lost / Found]],"<ref name="LostFound" /> the first episode of the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', which aired on [[Disney+]] on [[June 4]], [[2024]].<ref name="Announcement">{{SW|url=news/the-acolyte-teaser-poster|text=''The Acolyte'' Teaser Poster, Premiere Date Revealed}}</ref> Prior to the release of the episode, Nell was revealed in a trailer exclusively shown at [[Celebration Europe (2023)|Celebration Europe]]<ref name="Celebration">{{CelebrationTrailer|''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''|Celebration Europe (2023)}}</ref> during the [[Lucasfilm]] Studio Showcase on [[April 7]], [[2023]].<ref name="CelebrationDate">{{SW|url=news/swce-2023-lucasfilm-studio-showcase|text=SWCE 2023: 11 Highlights from Lucasfilm's Studio Showcase}}</ref> The character is visible in concept art of the Ueda Village Gate created by [[Kevin Jenkins]] and [[Stephen Tappin]].<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''</ref> The Ueda gate scene was shot at [[Shinfield Studios]],<ref name="Fantha Part I">{{WebCite|url=https://www.fanthatracks.com/news/the-acolyte-a-journey-to-the-filming-locations-part-1-madeira|text=The Acolyte: A journey to the filming locations Part 1: Madeira|archivedate=20241204220147}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:England|England]].<ref name="Julian Foddy">{{Lucasfilm|url=news/julian-foddy-acolyte|text=''The Acolyte'' Visual Effects Supervisor Julian Foddy}}</ref> Nell was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="AcolyteVG" />
